This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Harc Seff (V)]] (version 2 of 3). The current text is [[Harc Seff (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[Harc Seff (V)]]): Players Committee 2014 Virtual Set 0 release<ref name="eh1351-harc-0">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Players Committee Virtual Slips], Set 0 release. See also [http://www.holotable.com/download/downloads/holotable-large_images_postreset.tar.bz2 Holotable's December 2014 large image archive], Set 0 Light.</ref>. Dated 2014 (Virtual Set 0); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of Harc Seff (V) first published|section=On what day were the early Virtual Modern card versions first published?}} Text: “[Pilot] 2. For each of opponent's non-battleground locations on table, your Force generation is +1. Your leaders are deploy -2 to same site. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Players Committee Current Rulings, effective immediately<ref name="eh1351-harc-1">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1147604#p1147604 Players Committee Current Rulings], 25 September 2017, effective immediately.</ref>. First published 25 September 2017. The PC card image with this text and the “E” mark is in the Holotable repository by 8 July 2018 (commit 022435b). Text: “[Pilot] 2. For each of opponent's non-battleground locations on table, your Force generation is +1. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect.” '''What changed:''' game text: words removed: “Your leaders are deploy -2 to same site.”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Harc Seff (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-harc-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/harcseff.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022).</ref>. First published 31 July 2022. The Players Committee announced the remastered Virtual Set 0 images on 1 August 2022. Text: “[Pilot] 2. For each of opponent's non-battleground locations on table, your Force generation is +1. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”); the margin title lost its uniqueness dot. It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.
